name: kb_1081_Normalized

schema.description: A topology selector requirement is a selector that matches given label. This is an alpha feature and may change in the future.

key.description: The label key that the selector applies to.

values.description: An array of string values. One value must match the label to be selected. Each entry in Values is ORed.

description:
Dear Team,

Please note that the upcoming deployment will target only those nodes whose **region** label matches one of the approved locations. Specifically, any node labelled with either **us-east-1** or **us-west-2** will satisfy our topology selector requirement and be eligible for the rollout. Ensure that your inventory reflects these region values before proceeding.
